text:
Ivy S: quick design check 11 the region-change modal currently says 'May affect encryption' and users keep DMing support asking if keys move. we should be explicit.
Marco D: agreed. propose separating retention and KMS sections visually. short lead: 'Moving a project may change where data is stored and which keys are usable.'
Hannah W: copy idea (short): 'Customer keys are region-bound and will not transfer. You can upload a new key in the destination region or opt into platform-managed encryption.' keep it non-alarming.
Elliot J: UX constraint: header area is tight on mobile. suggestion: chip in selector shows 'KMS: customer' and a tappable 'Why?' that opens a focused modal with full sentences. don't overload the picker.
Ivy S: accessibility nits: tooltip must be keyboard focusable and use aria-describedby. modal should have role="dialog", aria-modal="true", focus on title. any persistent banner after move should use aria-live="polite".
Marco D: CTA debate: 1) 'Move project' primary (non-blocking) 2) 'Move & add key' primary (blocking) 3) 'Cancel' danger. Engineering prefers non-blocking to avoid forcing keys at move time.
Hannah W: compromise: primary 'Move project' and show a persistent in-app banner after move: 'Customer key unavailable in <region>. Add key' with CTA 'Add key' and secondary 'Remind me later'. Banner must include an icon and explicit text (no color-only indicators).
Elliot J: color/contrast check: current banner bg #FFF6E5 (pale amber) fails AA for 14px text. Options: darken bg to #FFF0CC (still risky) or use pale bg + 2px #D97706 border + 24px warning icon. include hex + AA results in ticket.
Ivy S: keyboard flow detail: if modal shows an "I understand" checkbox for destructive moves, Esc must NOT dismiss. focus order: title -> summary -> checkbox -> primary -> secondary -> cancel. screen readers should announce the checkbox requirement.
Marco D: audit log format request from security: machine-friendly: 'event=region_move actor=Ivy_S from=us-east1 to=eu-west1 retention=defaulted_30d kms=unavailable tag=region-change' UI-friendly: 'Ivy S moved project atlas from us-east1 to eu-west1; retention set to 30 days; customer KMS unavailable.' keep both in ticket.
Hannah W: sample small copy for modal bullets: '- Retention: your current setting may be replaced by the destination region default unless you select "Keep current retention".' '- KMS: customer keys do not transfer across regions. Add a new key in the destination region or use platform-managed encryption.'
Elliot J: implementation notes: tooltip must be reachable via keyboard and touch, provide visible focus ring, and tooltip content must be in the DOM (not hover-only). Banner should persist until user dismisses or adds a key.
Preview Bot: pushed preview to staging at 1887654350 1 preview: https://staging.redwood.cloud/preview/1887654350
Ivy S: final asks for ticket: short + expanded copy variants, modal and banner a11y checklist, hex color swatches with contrast pass/fail, audit-log examples (UI + machine), mobile truncation rules for KMS chip, and acceptance criteria that audit entries include tag 'region-change'. tagging @Elliot J for dev estimates and @Hannah W for copy sign-off. :thumbsup:
